info.title: Northstack Private API
info.description:
A REST API for your own scripts, Zapier, Make, or anything else you want to connect to your Northstack workspace. Manage keys from Settings → Integrations → API Keys.

An API key is not a person: it carries no role and no session. The scopes on the key are the only thing that determines what it can do — internal workspace roles/permissions don't apply to this traffic at all.

Every error response is the same shape: `{ "error": string, "code": string }`. A `400` from bad input additionally includes `details`, an array of `{ path, message }` naming exactly which field(s) failed.

post.description: Requires scope `tasks:write`. A Task is cross-entity — it hangs off exactly one Employee, Company, Contact, or Opportunity in your workspace.

404.description: entityId doesn't belong to your workspace

patch.description: Requires scope `tasks:write`. Send only the fields that change. `entityType`/`entityId` can't be changed — a Task can't move to a different record. Set `completedAt` to an ISO datetime to mark it done, or `null` to reopen it.

delete.description: Requires scope `tasks:write`. No request body. Hard delete — the row is gone; a GET afterward is a 404.

post.description: Requires scope `notes:write`. Same cross-entity shape as Tasks, minus assignee/due date/completion — a Note is a record, not a to-do.

example.description: Called the listed reference — confirmed dates and role.

example.description: Called the listed reference — confirmed dates and role.

404.description: entityId doesn't belong to your workspace

example.description: Updated after a second reference call.

delete.description: Requires scope `notes:write`. No request body. Hard delete.

post.description: Requires scope `crm.companies:write`. A Company can't exist without a Contact — `contact` is required, either a brand-new person or a link to one that already exists.

patch.description: Requires scope `crm.companies:write`. Same fields as create except `contact` (can't be changed this way), plus `parentCompanyId`. `statusId` is never settable directly — it's derived from business events (e.g. an Opportunity being won).

delete.description: Requires scope `crm.companies:write`. Optional JSON body. Without it, deleting a Company that still has Opportunities fails with a 400 instead of silently taking them down too.

patch.description: Requires scope `crm.contacts:write`. All create fields are optional, plus `isActive`.

delete.description: Requires scope `crm.contacts:write`. No request body. Soft delete — sets `isActive: false`, never destroyed. A linked Opportunity where this was the only active Contact gets deactivated too; otherwise it's just unlinked.

400.description: Validation error, or `ownerId` required (no automatic assignment on this pipeline)

patch.summary: Update an opportunity, including moving it to a new stage
patch.description: Requires scope `crm.opportunities:write`. There is no separate stage-change endpoint — send `stageId` here, alone or with other fields. If the target stage's outcome is `won` or `lost`, the matching reason field (`winReasonId`/`lossReasonId`) is required in the same request or you get a 400.

400.description: Validation error, or a win/loss reason is required for the target stage

delete.description: Requires scope `crm.opportunities:write`. No request body. Hard delete.

get.description: Requires scope `crm.pipelines:read`. Read-only — no write scope exists for Pipelines; they're configuration, not a record you create through automation.

200.description: A page of Pipelines, each with its stages

patch.description: Requires scope `hr.employees:write`. All create fields are optional, send only what changes. A terminated Employee's `statusId` can't be changed back this way.

delete.description: Requires scope `hr.employees:write`. No request body. Hard delete.

200.description: A page of Time Off Requests

post.description: Requires scope `hr.timeoff:write`. Creates a request only — there is no way to approve or reject one through this API: deciding a request is gated by "is this person's assigned manager", a relationship an API key doesn't have. The Employee must already have `timeOffPolicyId` assigned to them. If that policy doesn't require approval, the request comes back already `approved`.

example.decisionNote: Auto-approved — this policy does not require approval

400.description: Validation error, invalid date range, Employee/policy not found, or the policy isn't assigned to this Employee

get.description: Requires scope `hr.payroll:read`. Runs only — no payment-account data. No write scope exists for Payroll in this API; none can ever be requested on a key.

bearerAuth.description: An API key created from Settings → Integrations → API Keys, shown in full exactly once. Example: `Authorization: Bearer nk_live_...`

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: The id of the last row from the previous page.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, unknown, or revoked API key

Forbidden.description: Valid key, missing the required scope

example.error: This API key is missing the required scope: hr.employees:write

NotFound.description: Doesn't exist, or belongs to a different workspace (this API never confirms which)

BadRequest.description: Validation error — see `details` for which field(s)

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this key

example.error: Too many requests. Slow down and try again shortly.

assigneeId.description: A User id in your workspace.

completedAt.description: Set to mark done; set null to reopen.

CompanyContact.description: Either link an existing Contact, or create a new one.

isPrimary.description: Only one primary Contact per Company — setting this demotes any other.

stageId.description: Defaults to the pipeline's first active stage if omitted.

ownerId.description: Required only if the pipeline has no automatic assignment configured.

lossReasonId.description: Required if stageId resolves to a lost stage.

winReasonId.description: Required if stageId resolves to a won stage.

stageId.description: Send this to move the deal to a new stage.

statusId.description: Defaults to the workspace's default Employee status if omitted.

managerId.description: Another Employee id — must not create a reporting cycle.

statusId.description: Can't be changed back from a terminated status this way.

employeeId.description: Must already have timeOffPolicyId assigned to them.

startDate.description: A calendar date ("YYYY-MM-DD") or full ISO datetime.
